title: Prospective causal incorporation: matched-present-state, different-history challenge
status: PRE-REGISTERED — predictions fixed before outcome execution
researchBoundary: Prospective deterministic software specificity probe. No inference about consciousness, autonomous emergence, or an external Outside. No inferential p-values.
context: The 2026-10-15 exploratory 25-check audit previously showed history-dependent divergence. This is not an independent discovery or confirmatory population test.

conditioning.type: genuine endogenous step events produced by the existing runtime

pairing.commonPresent: After preconditioning, export the full active runtime, then import into paired arms; equality requires byte-identical zones, gates, governor, and current zone.

arms.RESET: reset only PFM, preserve matched present state
arms.H9: reset PFM, then inject one positive target-zone-9 memory event
arms.H0: reset PFM, then inject one identical positive target-zone-0 memory event
arms.SHAM: reset PFM, then inject one zero-flux event targeting zone 9

predictions.metric: L1 difference of ten zone activations, RETAIN vs RESET, at first post-pair step
Zone-9 activation, H9 minus H0, at first post-intervention step
Zone-0 activation, H0 minus H9, at first post-intervention step
Maximum absolute activation difference, SHAM vs RESET, at first step
Mean absolute difference in B concentration, H9 vs H0 fields after one coupled update

exploratoryMeasurements: discrete transition differences at steps 1 and 8

policy.thresholdEvaluation: Strict all-pairs rule; no cherry-picked subsets. Failed predictions recorded as failed.
policy.executionSeparation: Prediction JSON and source committed to main first. A later independent EXECUTE file push triggers outcome workflow.
policy.resultStatus: SUPPORTED iff all five predictions meet their registered directional thresholds for all 12 pairs; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED
